policy.atomic_snapshot: Player export and C3PO inventory must be acquired in one update run; roster.csv and mods.csv must be generated from that same acquisition before publishing.
policy.recent_changes: A change made within 30 minutes can legitimately differ between exports. Compare acquisition timestamps and never treat this alone as a data conflict.
policy.consumers: All optimizer versions must fetch these exact files from optimizer-data. Branch-local copies are runtime caches only.

notes: mods.csv was byte-identical on main and optimizer-v2 at bootstrap.

roster.csv was taken from optimizer-v2, the newer Comlink-derived snapshot. The known Major Partagaz star discrepancy reflects the recent in-game change reported on 2026-11-12 and is not treated as a conflict.
c3po.json was taken from main because optimizer-v2 already designates main as its canonical C3PO source; the prior sync step downloaded but did not persist it.
mod_profiles.json was taken from optimizer-v2 because it contains the larger current profile cache; main's copy is stale/incomplete.
The committed raw swgoh_972824625.json is excluded because it is not a reliable current snapshot and is not required by the optimizer inputs.
